cases.sentence: Высеки две каменные плитки, подобные прежним, и поднимись ко мне на ___
cases.translation: Cut two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on/to) with accusative case indicates motion toward or direction to a place.

cases.sentence: Я напишу на плитках слова, что были на первых плитках, которые ты разбил на ___
cases.translation: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke on the mountain
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with prepositional case indicates static location or a place where something happened.
The transitive verb 'сделай' (make) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Я сделал ковчег из дерева акации и положил плитки в ___
cases.translation: I made an ark of acacia wood and put the tablets in the ark
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (into) with accusative case indicates placing something into a container.

cases.sentence: В то время Господь отделил род Левия, чтобы они носили ковчег Завета ___, стояли перед Господом
cases.translation: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession—'ковчег Завета Господа' (the ark of the Lord's covenant).

cases.sentence: Вот почему у Левита нет доли и наследия среди своих ___
cases.translation: That is why the Levite has no portion or inheritance among his brothers
cases.explain: The genitive case after 'среди' (among) shows possession of the group.

cases.sentence: Я пробыл на горе сорок дней и ночей, как и в первый раз, и Господь снова внял ___
cases.translation: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, as before, and the Lord listened to me again
cases.explain: The verb 'внял' (listened) governs the dative case for the person to whom attention is given.

cases.sentence: Бойся Господа своего ___ и служи Ему
cases.translation: Fear the Lord your God and serve Him
cases.explain: The verb 'бояться' (to fear) governs the genitive case for the object of fear.

reading.ru: Тогда Господь сказал мне, Высеки две каменные плитки, подобные прежним, и поднимись ко мне на гору.
reading.question: What did the Lord command Moses to do after breaking the first tablets?
options: Go home and mourn for forty days
Cut two new stone tablets like the first ones and come to the mountain
Gather the people to confess their sins
Build a new altar for sacrifices
reading.correct: Cut two new stone tablets like the first ones and come to the mountain
reading.explain: The Lord's command states 'Высеки две каменные плитки, подобные прежним, и поднимись ко мне на гору' (Cut two stone tablets like the first and come up to me on the mountain).

reading.ru: Еще сделай деревянный ковчег. Я напишу на плитках слова, что были на первых плитках, которые ты разбил.
reading.question: Why was Moses instructed to make a wooden ark?
options: To store grain for the people
To place the stone tablets of the covenant in it
To serve as a burial vault
reading.correct: To place the stone tablets of the covenant in it
reading.explain: The Lord commanded Moses to 'сделай деревянный ковчег' and told him He would write on new tablets to replace the ones Moses broke, implying the ark would hold these tablets.

reading.ru: Смерть Аарона и служение левитов Израилетяне отправились от колодцев Айконитов в Масеру. Там Аарон умер и был похоронен.
reading.question: What happened to Aaron at a place called Moserah?
options: He was crowned as high priest
He built a new altar for God
He led the people in worship
reading.explain: The text states 'Там Аарон умер и был похоронен' (There Aaron died and was buried).

reading.ru: В то время Господь отделил род Левия, чтобы они носили ковчег Завета Господа, стояли перед Господом, служили Ему и благословляли Его именем.
reading.question: What specific functions did God assign to the tribe of Levi?
options: To rule over the other tribes and judge disputes
To carry the ark of the covenant, serve before God, and bless in His name
To oversee agriculture and manage the land
To organize the military forces of Israel
reading.correct: To carry the ark of the covenant, serve before God, and bless in His name
reading.explain: The text lists the Levites' duties: 'носили ковчег Завета Господа, стояли перед Господом, служили Ему и благословляли Его именем' (carry the ark, stand before the Lord, serve Him, and bless in His name).

reading.ru: Я пробыл на горе сорок дней и ночей, как и в первый раз, и Господь снова внял мне.
reading.question: How long did Moses spend on the mountain the second time, and what did God do?
options: Ten days of fasting, and God rejected his prayers
Forty days and nights, and the Lord listened to him again
Three days and nights in the wilderness
Seven days in communion with God
reading.correct: Forty days and nights, and the Lord listened to him again
reading.explain: The text states 'Я пробыл на горе сорок дней и ночей, как и в первый раз, и Господь снова внял мне' (I stayed on the mountain forty days and nights, as before, and the Lord listened to me again).

reading.ru: Вот почему у Левита нет доли и наследия среди своих братьев. Господь его наследие, как Господь твой Бог и сказал ему.
reading.question: Why did the Levites have no land inheritance like the other tribes?
options: Because they were considered unclean and unfit for land ownership
Because God Himself was their inheritance and portion
Because they chose to remain nomadic
Because they were punished for a rebellion against Moses
reading.correct: Because God Himself was their inheritance and portion
reading.explain: The text explains 'Господь его наследие' (the Lord is their inheritance), meaning God Himself was their portion instead of land.
